description: Track QC test vectors for grid.qc and the plugin's port, written by packages/grid/tests/test_qc_vectors.py. Each case is one file's soundings in file order, as [time in seconds since the epoch, lon, lat, depth in metres], with the file's arrival time in seconds since the epoch. Depths are float32 and times whole microseconds. Flags are [index, flag, reason].

cases.name: sentinels, implausible times and very shallow depths
a position jump rejects only the jumping sounding
a fast ship is not a jump
spikes are one-sided
spikes at a transit's ends are judged against one side
a transit of two soundings isn't judged for spikes
transits split at gaps of more than four hours
a transit ends every seven days
file order differs from time order
crossing the antimeridian is no jump, but a jump past it is
a boat moored on the antimeridian holding its depth isn't stuck
a depth held over a kilometre in deep water is a stuck sounder
a slow boat over a flat bottom isn't stuck
two equal soundings far apart are not a run
a moored boat holding its depth isn't stuck

a sounder stuck on a boat drifting in deep water is rejected
